entry.title: 研究資料寄存所團隊參與 2025 年國際資料週 (IDW 2025)

link.title: 研究資料寄存所團隊參與 2025 年國際資料週 (IDW 2025)

entry.content:
2025 年國際資料週 (International Data Week 2025; IDW 2025) 十月十三到十六日在澳洲布里斯本舉行，研究資料寄存所團隊參與了這場盛會。

於此次會議，研究資料寄存所由薛絲尹跟莊庭瑞組織了一場議程：《亞太地區的研究資料管理現況與前景》(Research data stewardship in the Asia Pacific – What is happening now and how to move forward?)。該場次邀集來自日本、新加坡、台灣共四組研究團隊共同討論。於此場次，我們以研究資料寄存所 (depositar) 出發，分享在台灣建造可永續的研究資料服務的經驗 (Building Sustainable Research Data Services in Taiwan: Experience from the depositar).

在 CODATA 所召集的 AI for Science 場次，莊庭瑞跟聖地牙哥超級電腦中心的 Christine Kirkpatrick 以 The Role of Data In AI for Science 為題，進行一場簡報。

2025 年國際資料週的議程由 CODATA、World Data System、以及 Research Data Alliance 所安排組織。此次大會係由「澳洲研究資料共有資源」(Australian Research Data Commons; ARDC) 籌辦並贊助。為期四天的會議中計有四場大會演講、107 場議程、以及 130 篇海報發表。八百多位參與者來自 75 個國家。

國際資料週兩年舉辦一次，下一次會議將於 2027 年九月二十到二十三日在南非開普敦舉行。

[_Research data stewardship in the Asia Pacific_](https://scidatacon.org/event/9/contributions/34/) 場次的講者。(Photo: Brian)
[_AI for Science — CODATA Convened Session_](https://scidatacon.org/event/9/contributions/233/) 場次的講者。(Photo: International Data Week 2025)

entry.title: depositar 資料收錄統計網頁上線

link.title: depositar 資料收錄統計網頁上線

entry.content:
stats.depositar.io 是研究資料寄存所 (depositar) 的資料收錄統計網頁，網頁針對研究資料寄存所中資料集的收錄情形，將各項統計數值以視覺化圖表的方式呈現，以利研究資料寄存所的使用者與管理者，以更加直觀的方式掌握研究資料寄存所當前的收錄情形。而網頁所呈現之統計資料，每日於台北時間凌晨三點自 depositar 自動更新。實作細節詳見技術說明。

本專案發表於 Open Repositories 2025，您可以在 depositar 或 Zenodo 取得摘要與簡報檔案。

以下將各自介紹 depositar stats page 現有的三個頁面：資料集統計、資料集趨勢，與後設資料整備情形。

資料集統計

此頁面呈現研究資料寄存所當天的資料集收錄現況，總共有四個主圖表：

  • 資料集數量分布：以柱狀圖繪製出不同後設資料欄位的資料集數量統計，並呈現中位數、平均數與眾數。例如統計在後設欄位「產製者」底下，呈現產製者數量的資料集數量分布。
  • 資料集樣態分佈：以面積圖繪製出不同資料集，呈現一後設欄位之下，各個後設欄位之值所擁有的資料集數量；同時，以圓餅圖與柱狀圖呈現擁有前 10 多筆資料集的後設欄位之值。例如使用者能依此看出擁有最多資料集的產製者，以及以擁有資料集數進行排序的收錄趨勢。
  • 資料集之最（依欄位值）：呈現各項後設資料欄位，擁有最多資料集之值。例如有最多資料集的專案、有最多資料集的產製者等等。
  • 逐日統計：以表格呈現一日的資料收錄情形。使用者可以對表格選擇特定日期、複製表格內容到剪貼簿，以及輸出成多種檔案格式。

資料集趨勢

此頁面呈現研究資料寄存所隨時間的收錄情況變化。使用者能夠選擇欲查看之時間區段，預設為呈現一年的統計趨勢。總共有兩個主圖表：

  • 總數變化趨勢：以面積圖呈現隨著時間，各項統計指標的變化。例如能夠繪製出隨著時間，資料集總數的增長情形。
  • 後設資料欄位項目趨勢：以多組折線圖繪製出各後設資料裡，各值隨時間的變化情形。例如統計在後設欄位「標籤」底下，呈現標籤數的資料集數量分布，讓使用者能夠看出有幾個資料集含有幾個標籤。

後設資料整備情形

此頁面呈現在當前研究資料寄存所中，資料集之後設資料的填寫率。此頁分成兩區，個別呈現兩種層級的後設資料填寫率。

  • 資料集後設資料填寫情況：以柱狀圖呈現當前所收錄之資料集，整體而言在資料集層級的後設資料填寫率。
  • 資源後設資料欄位填寫比例：以圓環圖呈現當前所收錄之資料集，整體而言在資源層級的後設資料填寫率。

entry.title: 2025 年網際網路典藏會議 (Web Archiving Conference, WAC) 報導

link.title: 2025 年網際網路典藏會議 (Web Archiving Conference, WAC) 報導

entry.content:
研究資料寄存所團隊參加了今年由國際網際網路保存聯盟（International Internet Preservation Consortium，簡稱 IIPC）所主辦的「網際網路典藏會議」（Web Archiving Conference，簡稱 WAC），該會議自 2016 年起舉辦至今已邁入第九年。今 (2025) 年由挪威國家圖書館 (National Library of Norway) 協辦，為期兩天涵蓋 50 場左右的議程及海報分享。本篇由王家薰報導摘要回顧這次會議的部分議程與海報內容，聚焦於實踐工具、國家政策及具啟發性的案例分享，期望提供讀者掌握國際上網際網路典藏發展趨勢。本文已刊載於《科技報導》2025 年 08 月號，同文亦刊於研究資料管理推進室。

2025 年網際網路典藏會議報導，刊於《科技報導》2025 年 08 月號。

entry.title: 活動宣傳：7 月 9 日研究資料聯盟與國際資料週 2025 網路說明會 - 台灣場次

link.title: 活動宣傳：7 月 9 日研究資料聯盟與國際資料週 2025 網路說明會 - 台灣場次

entry.content:
研究資料寄存所（depositar）受研究資料聯盟（Research Data Alliance, RDA）之邀，將在 7 月 9 日的台灣場次的網路說明會中，介紹我們的工作與經驗，除了 depositar 之外，ORCID 亞太區經理鄭潔之（Estelle Cheng） 也將在活動中分享她的觀察與經驗。

這場線上說明會是 RDA 在今年 6、7 月間舉辦的一系列地區活動之一，讓與會者可以：

  • 更加了解研究資料聯盟（Research Data Alliance），RDA 是一個全球性的社群組織，致力於促進不同學科、國家與技術間的資料共享與再利用。
  • 獲取 2025 國際資料週（International Data Week 2025） 的最新消息，該會議由國際科學理事會（International Science Council）旗下的資料委員會（Committee on Data）、世界資料系統（World Data System），以及 RDA 共同主辦，將於 2025 年 10 月 13 到 16 日在澳洲布里斯本舉行。
  • 認識在開放科學與資料共享領域工作的朋友，一起交流經驗與想法。

若你亦感到興趣，歡迎透過此 Eventbrite 連結報名參與。

延伸資源

  • 研究資料寄存所參加 2023 年國際資料週撰寫的報導：2023 國際資料週「資料節慶」 一窺研究資料管理發展
  • 研究資料寄存所於第 19 屆 RDA 第十九屆全體會議（plenary）發表的海報論文（2022）：推動良好的資料實作：從研究資料儲存庫走向研究資料管理（英文）
  • 研究資料寄存所於 2023 年國際資料週發表的海報論文：透過自下而上的資料管理計畫實作，培養研究資料管理文化（英文）

entry.title: Welcome, 2025 Summer Interns!
entry.content:
We welcome seven intern students to the depositar lab this summer! As part of the internship training, we organize short courses on Research Data Management (RDM), structured text, git, Jupyter Book, QGIS, OpenStreetMap, Wikidata, as well as 360° photos/videos & 3D models:

Course Instructor Date & Time
RDM & depositar Hilary Shiue & Tyng-Ruey Chuang July 2, 10:00 am
Linux command line & utilities Cheng-Jen Lee July 2, 2:00 pm
git & Jupyter Book Cheng-Jen Lee July 10, 10:00 am
QGIS Hsiung-Ming Liao July 14, 10:00 am
OpenStreetMap (lecture) Dennis Raylin Chen July 15, 2:00 pm
OpenStreetMap + Wikidata (hand-on) Dennis Raylin Chen July 16, 10:00 am
Open Science research tools Ming-Syuan Ho, Ally Wang & Ting-Yu Chuang July 22, 10:00 am
360° photos/videos & 3D models Yu-Huang Wang July 30, 10:00 am & 2:00 pm


By giving these short courses, we hope to introduce the students to the basics of research data management and static website generation, as well as to the use and enrichment of communal resources of geographic information and structured data. The courses will be held at the Institute of Information Science, Academia Sinica, and conducted in Taiwanese Mandarin. After taking these courses, the interns will work on individual projects.

We are very grateful to our guest lecturers: Dennis Raylin Chen (Wikimedia Taiwan), Ming-Syuan Ho (depositar lab alumni), Hsiung-Ming Liao (GIS Center, RCHSS, Academia Sinica), and Yu-Huang Wang (Nature Watch Ecological and Environmental Consultancy).

This year the summer internship students are from the National Cheng Kung University, the National Chung Cheng University, the National Sun Yat-sen University, the National Taiwan University, and the National Yunlin University of Science and Technology in Taiwan, and from the University of California San Diego in the US.

For a sampler of the individual projects developed by past interns, please take a look at these Jupyter Book pages.

entry.title: 研究資料寄存所團隊於第二十屆開放儲存庫國際會議 (OR2025) 進行報告

link.title: 研究資料寄存所團隊於第二十屆開放儲存庫國際會議 (OR2025) 進行報告

entry.content:
本月中旬在芝加哥大學舉行的第二十屆開放儲存庫國際會議 (20th International Conference on Open Repositories, #openrepos2025) 中，研究資料寄存所 (depositar) 團隊由王禮芳同學報告 “Automated Data Analytics: A Statistical Dashboard Built with GitLab CI/CD for a Data Repository Based on CKAN”。投影片可於研究資料寄存所下載 (ark:37281/k5w9w7145)。

以下為該場報告的摘要：

Automated Data Analytics: A Statistical Dashboard Built with GitLab CI/CD for a Data Repository Based on CKAN

Li Fan Wang (王禮芳), Cheng-Jen Lee (李承錱), and Tyng-Ruey Chuang (莊庭瑞)

This project presents a fully automated, cost effective, and highly available statistical dashboard providing an overview of the current status of the CKAN-based data repository depositar. The dashboard is built entirely with open-source tools and is automatically refreshed daily with the help of GitLab’s CI/CD pipelines. This practice demonstrates how to automate data analytics and visualization without incurring heavy costs, offering an innovative approach to collecting status data and sharing repository insights.

entry.title: The Depositar Team Presented at the 2025 Web Archiving Conference (WAC)

link.title: The Depositar Team Presented at the 2025 Web Archiving Conference (WAC)

entry.content:
The depositar team recently attended the Web Archiving Conference 2025 (WAC2025) in Oslo, Norway, and gave a presentation in the Discovery & Access (News/Newspapers) session. The following is the title and an abridged abstract of the presentation.

Recently Orphaned Newspapers: From Archived Webpages to Reusable Datasets and Research Outlooks

Tyng-Ruey Chuang, Chia-Hsun Wang, and Hung-Yen Wu

We report on our progress in converting the web archives of a recently orphaned newspaper into accessible article collections in IPTC (International Press Telecommunications Council) standard format for news representation. After the conversion, old articles extracted from a defunct news website are now reincarnated as research datasets meeting the FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) data principles. Specifically, we focus on Taiwan’s Apple Daily and work on the WARC files built by the Archive Team in September 2022 at a time when the future of the newspaper seemed dim. We convert these WARC files into de-duplicated collections of pure text in ninjs (News in JSON) format. …

Our work in transforming the WARC records into ninjs objects produces a collection of unique 953,175 news articles totaling in 4.3 GB. The articles are grouped by the day/month/year they were published hence it is convenient to look into a specific date for the news that were published on that day. Metadata about each article — headline(s), subject(s), original URI, unique ID, among others — are mapped into the corresponding fields in the ninjs object for ready access. …

The slideset and the script used in the presentation can be found at the depositar (ark:37281/k5p3h9k37).

Presentation from the depositar team at the 2025 Web Archiving Conference

entry.title: Year 2024 in Review
entry.content:
Sakura Blossom (Academia Sinica, Taipei, 2025-02-14)

On the last day of the first month of the Lunar New Year, we at the depositar lab wish you a joyful New Year. We take this occasion to summarize below our works from the previous year (2024-01 – 2024-12).

Hosted Projects and Datasets

  • There have been 2,661 datasets deposited and made public at the depositar, the research data repository we build and operate, by the end of Year 2024 (2024-12-31). The number of public datasets now grows to 2,725 (2025-02-27).

  • There are now 359 projects hosted at the depositar (2025-02-27).

System Upgrade and Enhancement

  • The system underlining the depositar (data.depositar.io) had been upgraded six times (from v6.6.3 to v6.7.1).

  • The CKAN package, which is the core of the depositar, has been updated to version 2.10 with email login, table view, Font Awesome 6.0 icons, and more.

Writing on Research Data Management (RDM)

  • Seven new articles appeared on the RDM Hub website.

  • Of the above, five were cross-posted on the Science and Technology Monthly website (on 2024-01-15, 2024-03-15,2024-05-15, 2024-09-30, and 2024-11-14).

Seminar and Outreach

  • We set up a booth for presenting the depositar services at the CABE 2024 Conference from January 22-24, 2024.

  • We gave a presentation on The Development of depositar—An Open Repository for FAIR Data (貼近 FAIR 資料原則的開放儲存庫——研究資料寄存所的發展) at the Center for GIS, RCHSS, Academia Sinica on Feb 27, 2024.

  • We gave a presentation at the National Tsing Hua University Library (Special Collection Division) on March 14, 2024.

  • We presented Research Data Management and Repository; The depositar — Introduction & Hands-on ( 研究資料管理與寄存；研究資料寄存所介紹與使用) at a user training workshop organized by the NSTC Core Computing Service (ASGC) in Academia Sinica on March 28, 2024.

  • We introduced data management planning and the depositar at the Long Term Socio-Ecological Research (LTSER) Data Management Plan (DMP) workshop in Taipei on April 1, 2024.

  • We collaborated with TaiBIF to host two DMP mini-workshops. Both workshops are held at the Biodiversity Research Center of Academia Sinica, one on May 22 and the other on November 8.

  • We gave a presentation on What Countries Are Releasing Data Strategies, What Should Taiwan Do? at COSCUP on August 3, 2024.

  • We gave a presentation on Small Teams in Contemporary Archiving: Reflection and Outlook at COSCUP on August 4, 2024.

  • We gave a presentation, titled Enhancing Research Reproducibility: Recent Tools and Policy Developments, at the National Cheng Kung University on August 19, 2024.

  • We gave a webinar at the invitation of the National Cheng Kung University Library, providing a tour of the depositar services on October 3, 2024.

  • We presented Small Teams in Contemporary Archiving: Reflection and Outlook at the invitation of the organizers of the 2024 Wikidata Cross-Domain Forum on October 27, 2024.

  • We participated in the Open Access Week at the National Taiwan Normal University. We delivered a presentation, titled An Introduction to Research Data Management by ways of Research Data Repositories (從研究資料儲存庫出發的研究資料管理實務), on October 29, 2024.

  • At the invitation of the CKAN community, we gave an overview of the depositar in English at the CKAN Monthly Live on November 20, 2024. About 50 people over the world attended.

  • We hosted an online English webinar on What is Research Data Management, and how can the depositar help? on December 12, 2024. More than 80 people, from Taiwan and elsewhere in the global, attended.

Presentation at International Conference

  • We gave a presentation, titled The Development of depositar—An Open Repository for FAIR Data, on Feb. 1, 2024, at an international conference hosted by the National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University Library.

  • We presented Bringing Computation and Reproducibility to a Data Repository Using Binder and Building An Open Repository for FAIR Data: Experience Sharing on Technologies, Communities, and Policies at Open Repositories 2024 (OR2024) in Göteborg on June 3-6, 2024 (conference report).

  • We present a poster, titled A Contemplation on Semantic Indexing with Persistent Identifiers, at Digital Humanities 2024 which took places at George Mason University on August 6-9, 2024. We are glad the poster received some feedback.

  • In a session on Research Data Management and Planning in the Humanities at the PNC 2024 Annual Conference and Joint Meetings, held in Seoul on August 29-31, 2024, we spoke about The Active Roles of Research Data Repositories in Cultural Landscape Documentation .

Internship Students, Visiting Scholar, and New Lab Member

  • A total of five internship students were received in the Summer of 2024. We organized short courses for the interns on RDM, Jupyter Book, QGIS, OpenStreetMap, Wikidata, among others. They also worked on short-term projects.

  • In addition, the lab continues to support several students with stipend on projects related to RDM, digital preservation, and data policies.

  • Dr. James X. Morris continues to visit the depositar lab. He is a postdoctoral scholar at the Center for GIS, RCHSS, Academia Sinica.

  • Hilary Shiue joined the depositar team in September as a Data Management Specialist. Ming-Syuan Ho, our project manager, departed at the end of October to take up a position at the National Institute of Cyber Security (NICS) of the Ministry of Digital Affairs (moda).

Serving Research Data Communities

  • We continue to work with the Long-term Social-Ecological Research Network (LTSER) program, funded by Taiwan’s National Science and Technology Council (NSTC), in fostering good data management practices.

  • We were asked to provide input to the Science & Technology Policy Advisory Office of the NSTC about scientific data policies.

  • Tyng-Ruey Chuang, the project lead of the depositar lab, serves as a consultant to the Trustworthy AI Dialogue Engine (TAIDE) project funded by NSTC.

  • Tyng-Ruey Chuang is serving in the Executive Committee of CODATA (Committee on DATA) at the International Science Cuncil for a third term.

  • Tyng-Ruey Chuang has been appointed to serve in the National Committees of CODATA, of Taiwan Biodiversity Information Facility, and of Future Earth Taipei.

  • Tyng-Ruey Chuang co-chairs Academia Sinica’s Generative AI Risk Study Committee in 2023, 2024 and 2025.

We wish you all a fruitful New Year! – Ally, Cheng-Jen, Hilary, Tyng-Ruey, and Winnie.

entry.title: 研究資料寄存所團隊於中研院地球所英文短講：研究資料管理及分享

link.title: 研究資料寄存所團隊於中研院地球所英文短講：研究資料管理及分享

entry.content:
研究資料寄存所 (depositar) 團隊受中研院地球所之邀，於 2025 年 2 月 13 日 Geotalk 活動分享研究資料管理與分享。

此次分享，depositar 團隊與地球所梁文宗博士及台灣大學地質系曾泰琳教授團隊協作，一起構想曾教授團隊的 Armenia Seismic Array 專案及資料集可以如何整理及分享。

這次的短講亦為 depositar 團隊首次與地球科學學者的聯繫及推廣。於此次協作及活動過程中，我們有機會深入了解地球科學領域對於研究資料保存的需求與挑戰。例如，地科研究資料的檔案數量與大小、資料集引用等細節，讓我們對研究資料管理的實踐有了更深刻的認識與體會。

簡報檔案可於研究資料寄存所取得：https://pid.depositar.io/ark:37281/k5x825v5q

莊庭瑞與短講簡報封面。(Photo by James X. Morris, CC BY-SA)
中研院地球所圖書館空間及當天聽眾與 depositar 團隊，投影幕上呈現 Armenia Seismic Array 專案。(Photo by ally, CC BY)
